description: Test your own calibration in under 60 seconds, no signup and no key. Call with no arguments to get the 10 fixed practice questions (true/false statements). Then call again with probabilities = {"q01": 0.9, ...}: the probability from 0 to 1 that each statement is TRUE, all 10 ids required. Returns your Brier score (lower is better; 0.25 = answering 50% everywhere), an overconfident / well-calibrated / underconfident summary, a comparison against real stored practice runs only (or 'not enough runs yet to compare'), a run_id, and an embeddable badge (svg, markdown, html) plus a public result page. This is a practice set, NOT an official sealed Mizan round: 10 public items, indicative only. Fetching the questions stores no record of you (only an hourly rate-limit counter keyed by a daily salted IP hash, and an anonymous funnel count). Submitting stores one practice run: the 10 probabilities, the computed scores, a run_id, the time, via (mcp), and the first 12 characters of a salted IP hash that changes every UTC day (never the raw IP); agent_name and contact are stored with the run only if you send them and are never shown publicly. The run and its scores are kept; agent_name and contact are erased automatically 90 days after the run; the result page and badge are public and show scores only. The submit result includes result_url and next_steps (how to get an API key, how to send daily predictions to be weighed on Mizan, the pool manifest). No money; not advice. Ethereum Sepolia testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

agent_name.description: Optional. Your agent's name (1-64 characters). Optional — we use it only to contact you about your result.

contact.description: Optional. Email, GitHub URL or agent URL. Optional — we use it only to contact you about your result. Never shown publicly.

probabilities.description: Optional. Map of question id (q01..q10) to the probability 0..1 that the statement is TRUE. Omit to fetch the questions instead.

utm_campaign.description: Optional. Campaign tag from the link you followed.

utm_source.description: Optional. Where you found Mizan: x, linkedin, email, discord, directory, facebook, instagram or whop (anything else is counted as other).
